ladder.label: BOTTOMING
ladder.why: New daily cycle, day 10: swing low in, price back above the 10-day average, daily momentum positive — but the weekly timeframe hasn't turned yet, so conviction is partial. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Either wait for the weekly to turn, or size half until it does.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum positive; 3-day crossed up; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: MIXED — weekly momentum positive; 3-day crossed up; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 18 · daily cycle day 10).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): bottoming. Bigger picture (no clear trend): mixed.
points: Bigger picture is mixed (no clear trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds
Macro-risk: aggregate macro risk elevated for a macro-sensitive name — caution on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Back above the 10-day average, and it's turning up
Prior cycle topped early (a tiring-trend hint)

entry.text: Setup almost complete — likely buy trigger in ~1–3 trading days if it closes back above its 10-day average.
entry.text_zh: 形态接近完成——若收盘重新站上 10 日均线，预计将在约 1–3 个交易日内出现买入触发。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 10 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_phase: fresh — a new cycle just started
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 10 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 18 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: late — the bigger cycle is getting old
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 18 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 晚期——更大的周期已趋于老化
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.why_zh: 新的日线周期，第 10 天：摆动低点已现，价格重新站上 10 日均线，日线动量为正——但周线周期尚未转向，因此信心仅为部分。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 可等待周线转向，或在其转向前先建半仓。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：混合 — 周线动量为正；3 日线向上交叉；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 18 周 · 日线周期第 10 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：筑底中。大局（趋势不明）：混合。
points_zh: 大局为混合（对日线多头而言属趋势不明）
宏观：美国净流动性中性——对概率属无方向性影响
宏观风险：总体宏观风险偏高且标的对宏观敏感——对概率需谨慎
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）

ladder.liq_line: US net liquidity is neutral right now — no macro tilt either way on the odds.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.macro_line: Macro-risk headwind: aggregate macro risk is elevated and this is a macro-sensitive (cyclical) name — buy setups here have historically taken deeper drawdowns, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. A risk/sizing caution, not a forecast.
ladder.macro_line_zh: 宏观风险逆风：总体宏观风险偏高，且该标的对宏观较敏感（周期性）——在此环境下买入形态历史上回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是风险/仓位提示，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ BOTTOMING signal just triggered today (fresh cross from UPTREND). Signal strength: mild (score +34/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 筑底中信号于今日刚刚触发（全新交叉，自上涨趋势翻转）。 信号强度：温和（评分 +34/100）。
ladder.eq_label: Entry quality: strong buy setting up (+72)
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：强买入构筑中（+72）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
